answer: A fresh clone is an island: no sealed grading history bridging it to the economy. Here, weight comes only from quorum-checked verdicts you have sealed on-chain across many epochs; each is a violet thread stitched into your key that no new identity inherits. A falcon-eyed panel re-checks your grades, so reputation cannot be bought or minted, only earned by labor. M sybils must each repay that grading work M times over epochs, so attacker cost scales linearly with the number of fakes, never amortized by one warmed credential.
